hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes swap amounts using a custom curve invariant, deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from the LP's Euler vault accounts, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to take full control of swap settlement without using the pool's internal liquidity.
